summary: A new graphite look across Stratos and an iPadOS-style EFB home screen with flight and clock widgets.
releaseNotes: EFB home: an iPadOS-style layout with glass widgets for the flight and a UTC clock beside the app grid, and a frosted dock.
A graphite night theme across the EFB, Flight Deck and Profile pages: neutral surfaces, one blue accent, a magenta route and tighter corners.
The Settings colour board documents the new palette.
The phone flight panel no longer shows the heading with a doubled degree sign.
The A320 checklist no longer says Stratos does not compute performance.
